intro.text: The Cognitive Realm of the Rosharan system, home to the spren.

description.text: Land and water reverse their positions relative to the Physical Realm. Seas of beads represent physical objects.
The Shin call Shadesmar Makari Sin.

items.text: Cultivation's departure closed her perpendicularity, leaving travelers such as Shallan searching for another route into the Physical Realm. Spren could now leave Roshar, while time dilation complicated communication with other worlds.
